modalLead: A polish pass on dialog windows for smoother keyboard and screen-reader navigation, plus quieter, more standards-compliant browser behaviour.

items.text: Focus handed back cleanly — when a dialog closes, keyboard focus now returns to the control that opened it before the dialog is hidden, so keyboard and screen-reader navigation stays tidy and the browser console no longer warns that focus was trapped in a hidden element.

More reliable opening focus — dialogs now place the cursor on their first control as soon as they finish opening, without depending on a fixed animation delay, so focus lands consistently across layouts and slower devices.
No accidental submits — dialog buttons can no longer submit a surrounding form by accident, so confirm and cancel always do exactly what they say.

Quieter, standards-compliant install support — added the standard add to home screen meta tag alongside the older Apple-specific one, so Chrome no longer logs a deprecation warning and progressive-web-app install works consistently across browsers.
